findings.message: Entry param page (filter:despesasPendentes, persisted) has no state in the definition. Added the public persisted state `page` (number | null) that records the page reached with a pager; listarDespesasPendentesEquipe(page, append) writes it only when not appending.

Command rejeitarDespesa needs a typed reason but the definition has no <command>.input state. Added the public state `rejeitarDespesaDraft` (RejeitarDespesaDraft) with setter setRejeitarDespesaDraft; id and version come from the loaded despesa.

The selection state selectedDespesa (entry.params.despesaId) is written by no request setter. The selection is done through obterDespesaParaAnalise(despesaId | null), which publishes selectedDespesa and loads the record into despesa.

aprovarDespesa and rejeitarDespesa return the updated despesa, which no state has as source. Applied as the route comments say: redraws despesa and removes the row from the pending queue (despesas.items) without reload.
public page is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public rejeitarDespesaDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public setRejeitarDespesaDraft is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
